overview_description.description: Supy is a software company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Dubai, focused on building digital solutions for the food and beverage (F&B) industry. It provides an all-in-one platform designed specifically for multi-location restaurant groups to manage back-of-house operations such as inventory tracking, procurement, supplier management, and business intelligence. The platform acts as an “operating system” for restaurants, enabling real-time visibility into stock levels, food costs, and purchasing activities. It automates workflows like purchase orders, invoice processing, and stock counting while integrating with POS, ERP, and accounting systems.

about_short_description.short_description: Supy is a B2B software solution focused on streamlining transactions between restaurants and suppliers.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: A software module that provides real-time tracking of stock levels, usage, and waste across multiple restaurant locations.

product.name: Procurement Software
product.description: A tool that automates purchase orders, manages supplier relationships, and tracks supplier pricing and invoice discrepancies.

product.name: Menu and Recipe Engineering Software
product.description: A module for standardizing recipes and portion sizes to ensure consistent food cost and accurate stock depletion.

product.name: Invoices and Settlements Software
product.description: A system that automates invoice matching, dispute resolution, and credit note generation for supplier invoices.

product.name: Restaurant Analytics Software
product.description: A reporting tool that provides detailed analytics dashboards on sales trends, inventory movements, and food cost metrics.

product.name: Professional Services
product.description: Consulting and support services to assist with implementation, training, and optimization of Supy’s software solutions.
